items.title: telephony_sms

about.title: I like the part where it works.
about.body1: I’m Khaled — a senior engineer who’s genuinely fond of this craft and won’t pretend otherwise. Five-plus years moving between a Flutter screen, a backend service, and the Terraform that puts them in front of people.
about.body2: I care about the unglamorous middle: the error message that respects your time, the migration that doesn’t wake anyone at 3 a.m., the pipeline that makes shipping a non-event. Serious about the work, light about myself.
